models_evaluated: ASA physical status prediction model (lower- vs higher-risk)

links.outcome: Discrimination and calibration of pre-operative risk models in external validation at a second NHS Trust
links.effect: ASA model at threshold 0.2 had recall 0.69 and precision 0.95 for lower-risk patients; mortality model discriminated well but was poorly calibrated externally.
links.quote: The mortality prediction model discriminated well in external validation but was poorly calibrated, lending support to the existing literature showing that hospital-specific modelling improves mortality risk prediction.

unlisted_practices: Constraining model input variables to those available electronically in real time across all UK surgical patients
Certified electronic linkage of GP Connect records into a live pre-operative assessment system

screen.reason: The study develops and externally validates machine learning models for pre-operative risk stratification linked into a live electronic health record software architecture, but evaluates retrospective external validation cohorts without testing a specific deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
